recognize_zh: 骨髓切片印片（touch imprint）上成片的芽細胞，核質比高、核形不規則並有凹陷或裂溝、染色質細緻、細胞質淡藍含小空泡，幾乎看不到成熟造血細胞；芽細胞為主，符合 AML。
features: Sheets of blasts with virtually no maturing hematopoietic elements
High N:C ratio with irregular, notched or cleaved nuclear contours
Fine chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Pale blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles; no definite Auer rods
Background of bubbly lipid/crush artifact typical of an imprint preparation
describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of blasts with essentially no residual maturing hematopoietic cells. The blasts have a high N:C ratio, irregular nuclear contours with notches and occasional cleaves, fine chromatin, and pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm. No definite Auer rods are identified, and a bubbly background artifact is present from the imprint technique. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, in this clinical setting therapy-related.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with delicate nuclear folds and are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64 expression.
Lymphoblasts may also have irregular nuclei; MPO negativity and lymphoid markers by flow cytometry separate them.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters or rosettes and are CD45-negative, whereas these blasts are dyscohesive.
